openedFailedRun.failureMessage: GetPath() missing 2 required positional arguments: 'dst_path' and 'dst_len'

frozenRetryDelta.cause: Apple's bundled LLDB Python SBFileSpec.GetPath requires a destination buffer and length, while upstream LLVM 21 exposes a zero-argument convenience binding.
frozenRetryDelta.allowedSourceChange: In diagnostic module-path formatting only, replace SBFileSpec.GetPath() with GetDirectory()/GetFilename() and join those returned strings without consulting target memory.

frozenQuestion.objective: Capture the exact Apple instruction PCs and call stacks that change the already-proven private crop fields, with the identical first-run code, object, watchpoint, event, and semantic gates.
frozenQuestion.entryRule: Set one pending breakpoint by the exact capture_backdrop symbol. On its first hit, read exactly 0x4000 bytes from the symbol address and require SHA-256 14f25960556bec9e88ba8ade176ee7f1d39b84726226ade3eb1b0f1be00b70d2 before setting a one-shot breakpoint at symbol+0x2b58.
frozenQuestion.objectRule: At symbol+0x2b58 require source=x19, owner=x20, layer=x24, layerState=*(layer+0x10), *(source+0x48)=owner, *(layerState+0x120)=source, and exact equality of source+0x50, layerState+0xb0, and owner+0xe0 after their fixed int32/binary64 decoding.
frozenQuestion.watchpointRule: Arm exactly four 8-byte hardware write-on-modify watchpoints: source+0x50, owner+0xe0, owner+0x248, and the currently live layerState+0xb0. Retain at most six changed-value events per watchpoint and at most 24 events total. A debugger callback never mutates target memory and returns false to resume the target.
frozenQuestion.eventRule: For each event retain the exact before and after eight bytes, stop PC, thread ID, at most 32 frames, all six private post-write fields, and one deduplicated mapped code window. A resolved writer symbol retains exactly 0x1000 bytes from its symbol start; an unresolved writer retains exactly 0x400 bytes beginning 0x200 bytes before the stop PC.
frozenQuestion.integrityRule: Require exactly four distinct hardware watchpoint indices, at least one changed QuartzCore event for every preregistered field, contiguous per-field hit indices, exact code-window hashes, zero LLDB failures, and a finalized raw trace.
frozenQuestion.semanticSeal: The CI validator may prove only trace integrity and writer-PC capture. Function semantics, writer order, arithmetic, and the public layer-state crop rule remain sealed until the artifact is opened after the run.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: Any new API mismatch, missing symbol, changed code hash, partial object chain, unavailable hardware slot, missing field event, non-QuartzCore writer, partial code window, callback failure, or target failure fails closed and remains an uploaded artifact.
